notes: Ranking exists because compute is finite. Nine armed threat rows and one
card that fits four grids is the normal case, not the edge case, so the
order has to be a decision the machine makes and publishes rather than one
an operator makes and forgets.
THE INTENSITY TERM'S SCALE IS 1.0, AND THAT IS THE FIX. In v1 it was
3000.0, in the units of one field, and every row's intensity was divided by
it: pascals and decibels were summed on one axis and differed 470x from
units alone. The units now come off at the METRIC ROW, which is the only
thing that knows what its own field measures, through
rank.intensity_reference. What is left here is a dimensionless gain, and
setting it to anything other than 1.0 changes how much intensity counts
against persistence, travel and extent -- uniformly, for every class.
THE EXTENT TERM'S SCALE IS ALSO 1.0, AND FOR THE SAME REASON, FOUND THE
SAME WAY. Square kilometres ARE shared units, which is exactly what made
that term look safe. The distributions are not shared: on the same 24 h
global forecast a cyclone core reached 517,000 km2 and a convective region
211,000 km2, while a moisture corridor reached 11,433,855 km2 -- one
connected region over two per cent of the planet. Against a scale of
200,000 km2 that single term scored 14.29, more than four times any other
candidate's whole score, and took two of the four slots for a swath that
could cover three per cent of the feature. Extent is now a FRACTION: the
raw area divided by the area this row's own swath could resolve
(maximum_cells_per_swath times the cell area at the row's spacing),
saturating at one. Nothing was typed to make that reference exist.
persistence AND travel ARE FRACTIONS TOO, and the third time this defect
appeared it was found by reading the receipt rather than by a run going
wrong. Their units are shared but their CEILINGS belong to the cycle: a
track cannot last more frames than the forecast published, and it cannot
travel further than its own speed gate over the forecast's span. Against
a fixed scale of 8 frames, a 25-frame forecast let persistence reach 3.1
on its own -- 1.56 of a winning score of 4.97, at a weight of 0.5 -- while
an 8-frame forecast caps the same term at 1.0, so the same document
ranked differently for a reason that was about the output interval.
Both now divide by what the cycle made possible.
SO INTENSITY IS THE ONLY UNBOUNDED TERM, deliberately: a storm twice as
deep as its row's reference should be able to run away with the ordering,
while a storm that lasted the whole forecast has reached a ceiling and
there is nothing further to reward. Every scale here is 1.0 because every
reference now comes from the row or the cycle; the WEIGHTS are the only
free numbers left in the ordering, which is where preference belongs.
budget.maximum_per_threat_class IS A CORRECTNESS PROPERTY, not a taste.
THE BREAKAGE IT PREVENTS, measured on a real 24 h global forecast: the
detector formed 258 tracks -- 41 cyclone and 217 deep-convection -- and the
twenty-seven highest-ranked candidates of 205 were all cyclones, so a
budget of four placed four cyclones and none of the 217 convective regions
the same forecast held. Commensurable units put the classes on one axis;
they do not make the atmosphere interleave them. Two per class against a
budget of four means a cycle can never spend more than half its compute
watching one kind of weather.
The cap applies to INCUMBENTS too. A cap that exempted dwell-protected
slots could not take effect on the only cycle it matters on -- the one that
already holds a full class -- so the first cycle after this policy is armed
against a state file written under the old one can evict a protected slot.
That is a one-time cost and it is the intended one.
The tiebreak ends in feature_id, which is unique within a cycle, so the
order is TOTAL. Without that last key two candidates equal on score and
class would be admitted in detector-emission order, and the same history
file could produce two different plans on two machines.
The hysteresis block is a correctness property, not polish. See
hexcore.swath.registry.Hysteresis for the breakage it prevents and
evidence/swath-following-20260826/ for the measurement that sets these
numbers.
budget.maximum_swaths is 4 for a 16 GiB card at a 6 h cadence: the
measured wall clock admits 7 sequential swath chains in 360 min, and 4
keeps 39 percent of the cycle in reserve for one re-cull or one retry. A
cycle that overruns places the NEXT cycle's swaths from a stale coarse
forecast, which shows up on the frame as a swath lagging its storm with
nothing on the image to explain why.
